log_text: 2025-02-12 TOP-DRIVE-02 FLT-0521 gearbox oil running over temperature drained and replaced the gearbox oil it is beyond what can be done on site and has been escalated to onshore engineering logged by Priya Raman
MUD-PUMP-01 had FLT-0417 showing liner worn and discharge pressure low. Fitted a new liner to address the issue. The unit is running but still waiting on parts to finish the job. 18/02/2025 SM

February 26, 2025, MUD-PUMP-02 was serviced due to a fault code FLT-0392 indicating a piston seal leak at the fluid end. The piston seal was changed out to address the issue, but the fix is temporary and a follow-up check is still needed next shift. Eriksen logged the entry.

25 February 2025, worked on TOP-DRIVE-01, fault code FLT-0521 showed up for gearbox oil running over temperature, so I drained and replaced the gearbox oil, the fault has cleared and the job is closed out, logged by James Okafor.

BOP-STACK-01 was worked on February 1, 2025. Fault code FLT-0633 was shown on the panel indicating an annular preventer element was leaking. An annular element swap was carried out but it is beyond what can be done on site and has been escalated to onshore engineering. TH

I worked on SHALE-SHAKER-01 during this shift and observed fault code FLT-0719 displayed on the panel, indicating that the vibrator motor failed. I replaced the vibrator motor according to procedure, but the problem persists and has been escalated to the maintenance supervisor. Logged by Sarah McAllister.
BOP-STACK-01 had FLT-0610 showing accumulator pressure low. Recharged the accumulator bottles and tested OK afterwards, returning to service. Work done on 2025-02-17. Logged by M. Kowalczyk.

February 21, 2025. Worked on DRAWWORKS-01, which showed FLT-0802 on the panel indicating the brake pads were worn beyond limit. New brake pads fitted and everything checked out, so the unit is back in service and running normally. Just hoping it holds up through the next few shifts.
SHALE-SHAKER-03 3 February 2025 FLT-0719 vibrator motor failed motor swap carried out tested OK afterwards and returned to service Eriksen
TOP-DRIVE-02 had FLT-0538 showing high vibration on the main bearing. Replaced the main bearing and tested the unit. The fault has cleared and the job is closed out. Logged by D. Patel. 19/02/2025.

BOP-STACK-01 was serviced on February 16, 2025 for FLT-0610, which indicated accumulator pressure low. Accumulator pre-charge was restored, but the fault came back and has been escalated to the OEM for support. Logged by James Okafor.
